lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Hi! I'm Rani, a senior analyst at the Nusa Digital SOC desk. Welcome to your first day!

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: SOC stands for Security Operations Center: the team that keeps our office and our clients safe every day.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Open a case from the Queue, then tap anything suspicious to mark it as evidence.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Then decide: ALLOW, BLOCK, or ESCALATE (hand it to a senior analyst) if you're not sure.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Confused? Open the Handbook. One more thing: press and hold, or right-click, a link to see its real address.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: First shift done! Check your report, especially the cases you missed. That's where we learn the most.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: Nusa Digital has a new analyst, huh? Let's see how careful they are.
